sentences.text: HON'BLE MRS. JUSTICE SINDHU SHARMA, JUDGE
The instant application has been moved by the applicants under Order 1 Rule 8 of CPC for grant of permission to file the present writ petition in the representative capacity.
For the reasons stated in the application, coupled with the submission made at the bar, the same is allowed.
The applicants are allowed to file the present writ petition in their representative capacity.

01. The petitioners seek a direction upon the respondents to release/disburse the compensation for the land due to them in terms of final award No. SDMR/LA/2018-19/75-79, dated 16.10.2018, for the land acquired by the respondents for the construction of a road from Massal to Kanal in village Birnoo, Tehsil Ramnagar, District Udhampur.

02. The grievance of the petitioners is that despite the land having been acquired by the respondents for the construction of the road and the final award being issued, and also the apportionment statement prepared by the Collector Land Acquisition (Sub-Divisional Magistrate), Ramnagar,
District Udhampur, the respondents have not released the compensation due to beneficiaries in terms of the Land Acquisition Act.
Residents Of Village Birnoo vs Ut Of J&K And Others on 8 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192135269/
1 03.

Ms. Aparna Gupta, Advocate, appearing vice Mrs. Monika Kohli, learned Sr. AAG, accepts notice on behalf of respondents No. 2 and 5, whereas Ms. Pallavi Sharma, Assisting Counsel to Mr.
Ravinder Gupta, learned AAG, accepts notice on behalf of respondents No. 1, 3, and 4.
05.

Respondent No. 5 shall file an affidavit explaining why the amount of compensation has not been released in favor of the beneficiaries despite the passing of the final award and the apportionment statement.

06. The respondent No. 5 shall file an affidavit within a period of two weeks, explaining reasons for not releasing the amount of compensation in favour of the beneficiaries despite completion of acquisition proceedings and passing of the final award dated 16.10.2018.
07.
Michal Sharma/PS authenticity of this document.
